title: Fundly

description.en: China mutual-fund browser and ranking tool with local SQLite and Railway
description.zh: 中国公募基金浏览与排名工具，采用本地 SQLite 存储并部署于 Railway。

subject: White flame on an orange rounded square

source.description: China mutual-fund browser and ranking tool with local SQLite and Railway

subject.en: A worldly navy-and-ivory penguin holding binoculars
subject.zh: 手持望远镜、见多识广的深蓝与象牙白企鹅

description.en: A compact whole penguin has lowered its binoculars and turns with calm curiosity. The navy body sits to the right while the instrument reaches into the left-hand space. Complete feet and feather tips stay comfortably inside the rounded viewfinder.
description.zh: 企鹅刚放下望远镜，带着平静的好奇回望。完整而紧凑的身体偏右，望远镜伸向左侧留白；脚趾与羽尖均在圆角取景框内保留充分空间。

description.en: Broad connected navy and indigo facets contrast with an opaque warm-ivory face and bib. The flippers support one brass-and-teal binocular instrument. Its lens facets form the sole multicolored accent group without covering the eyes.
description.zh: 连贯的深蓝与靛蓝色块衬托暖象牙白面部和腹部。双鳍自然托着黄铜与青色望远镜，镜片中的彩色碎片构成唯一一组多彩兴趣点，双眼保持清晰。

description.en: Mineral-blue paper opens into broad horizon arcs and short sighting ticks. The curves follow the penguin’s gaze and remain visible beside the dark body. Grain and contact shadows are independent of the transparent foreground.
description.zh: 矿物蓝纸面铺开宽阔的地平线弧与简短瞄准刻线，顺着企鹅的视线延伸，在深色主体旁保持可见。颗粒和接触阴影与透明前景分别保存。

palette.source: Selected local presentation, fundly/2026-09-07-01/02; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: The navy-and-ivory silhouette and lowered binoculars remain the main small-size cues. At 16 px the individual lens colors and eye facets merge. The 24 px sidebar and 16 px browser samples use the transparent penguin without its paper tile.
sizeNote.zh: 深蓝与象牙白轮廓、放下的望远镜是小尺寸下的主要识别点；16 px 时镜片彩色与眼部色块会合并。24 px 侧栏和 16 px 浏览器样例采用不带纸面底图的透明企鹅。

goal.en: Collect fund and market data for private research into Chinese funds, ETFs, stocks, and macro conditions.
goal.zh: 采集基金与市场数据，用于研究中国公募基金、ETF、股票与宏观环境。

role.en: Collection scripts, HTTP server, and tests
role.zh: 采集脚本、HTTP 服务与测试

role.en: Local market data and computed metrics
role.zh: 本地市场数据与计算指标

role.en: Bun hosting with a persistent data volume
role.zh: Bun 服务与持久数据卷

description.en: Broad horizon bands open toward the penguin’s gaze, with restrained sighting ticks in the distance.
description.zh: 宽阔地平线朝企鹅的视线展开，远处只留少量观测刻度。

alt.en: A worldly navy-and-ivory penguin holding binoculars on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 手持望远镜、见多识广的深蓝与象牙白企鹅，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.en: A measured view of the market.
caption.zh: 以从容的视野，观察基金。

description.zh: 手持望远镜、见多识广的深蓝与象牙白企鹅。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥67px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 67px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
